WITH operator_rates AS (
  SELECT crewref, AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY crewref
), overall_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_rates
), qualifying_operators AS (
  SELECT crewref, avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_rates
  WHERE avg_gb_per_min > (SELECT avg_gb_per_min FROM overall_rate)
), operator_scan_counts AS (
  SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
)
SELECT AVG(osc.scan_count) AS average_scans,
       AVG(qo.avg_gb_per_min) AS average_gb_per_min,
       AVG(qo.avg_gb_per_min) - (SELECT avg_gb_per_min FROM overall_rate) AS average_excess_gb_per_min
FROM qualifying_operators qo
JOIN operator_scan_counts osc ON osc.crewref = qo.crewref;
